[[File:Silka_beads.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka Tano's Padawan braid, made from silka beads]]

'''Silka beads''' were a type of decorative bead found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
The beads were a neutral green to grey color and have been shown to be carved into spheres. These beads were known to be incorporated in both the hair and chain [[Padawan braid/Legends|braids]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

==History==
[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], a Padawan to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], used Silka beads to create her Padawan braid. While on a mission to intercept [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] Tano was paralyzed and rendered unconscious by Bane. The bounty hunter placed his Padawan hostage in [[Stuncuffs/Legends|Stun cuffs]], and pulled off one of her Silka bead Padawan braids. Distracted by freeing Tano, Bane escaped the room with the holocron and the Padawans braid.<ref name="Cargo of Doom">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref> After hunting down Cad Bane, Skywalker and Tano arrived to secure a Force sensitive Gungan child. Bane then sneaked into the Gungan child's room, only to find Tano waiting for him. They engaged in a small fight before he was captured, after which Tano took back her Padawan braid.<ref name="Children of the Force">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>

After the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Tano was believed to be the perpetrator of these crimes. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] decided to cast Ahsoka from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]], removing her status as a Padawan, stripping her of her Padawan braid as a symbolic gesture, and leaving her a civilian under the jurisdiction of the Senate. The charges against Ahsoka were eventually dropped once the [[Barriss Offee/Legends|true mastermind]] was found, leading to the Council apologizing for their actions. Anakin offered to return the Padawan braid that he had kept for her, but to everyone's shock, Ahsoka refused and left the temple and the Jedi Order.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Silka beads were first identified as such in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decoded|Decoded]] version of "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]." They, however, first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novel]] as Tano's braid.
